flags.message: Forward-mode companion signal, disclosed as hygiene: the Sixth Circuit companion petition Ream v. Department of the Treasury (No. 26-93) was fetched from supremecourt.gov and shows it was rescheduled off the 9/28 conference and re-distributed for the same 10/9/2026 conference as this petition, with eleven amicus entries. This public, pre-snapshot information about a different docket raised my grant probability; it reveals nothing about this case's own disposition, which does not yet exist.
